rows.grounds: mantra syllables kept byte-exact; ṭhaṃkāra denotes the syllable ṭhaṃ
gerund indicating prior extraction or utterance of the mantra element
refers to the formulaic word or pada to be uttered
dative recipient of obeisance, epithet Lāṅgalin
formula of salutation addressed to the named recipient

items.question: What mantra formula and salutation follow the extraction of the ṭhaṃ syllable?
premises: The syllable oṃ ṭhaṃkāraṃ is extracted.
The word padaṃ is then uttered.
Obeisance namaḥ is directed to Lāṅgalin.
items.inference: After extracting oṃ ṭhaṃkāraṃ, one utters the pada followed by obeisance to Lāṅgalin.
uncertainties: Whether padaṃ refers to a specific fixed word or a general formulaic element is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Having extracted the syllable oṃ ṭhaṃ, one should utter the word and offer obeisance to Lāṅgalin.
